_evidence: 0x0052f429: 'call 0x54d755' translates al through the 256-byte table 0x833e18 (zero in the image, filled at start-up from CharLowerA by 0x54d70c; any byte is a valid entry, see xlat_00833e18), then 'sub al,0x61; movzx ecx,al; jecxz' - a translated 'a' gives n = 0 and the jecxz exit (0x52f43a taken), which the zero image table (n = 0x9f) never reached - and counts the set bits among the low n bits of [0x81e5d4] ('shr ebx,1; jae; inc eax; dec ecx; jne'). Entries are drawn from 'a' (often), other letters b..z (n = 1..25, partial masks), and bytes below 'a' or above 'z' (n wraps to 0x80..0xff: the whole mask); the mask dword is random. Plain data: every value is valid.
